tool.name: lissero
tool.command: cp '$input1' input.fna && lissero #if $settings.advanced == "advanced" --min_id $settings.min_id --min_cov $settings.min_cov #end if input.fna > output1 && sed -i '1!s|^[^\t]*/||' output1 && python $__tool_directory__/variant4b.py output1 output2.txt ${input1.element_identifier};

param.name: min_id
param.label: Minimum percent identity to accept a match

param.name: min_cov
param.label: Minimum coverage of a gene to accept a match

tool.help:
Usage: lissero [OPTIONS] FASTA...
In silico serogroup prediction for L. monocytogenes. Alleles: lmo1118, lmo0737, ORF2819, ORF2110, Prs
References:
Doumith et al. Differentiation of the major Listeria monocytogenes serovars by multiplex PCR. J Clin Microbiol, 2004; 42:8; 3819-22
Options: -h, --help Show this message and exit. --min_id FLOAT Minimum percent identity to accept a match. [0-100][default=95.0] --min_cov FLOAT Minimum coverage of the gene to accept a match. [0-100][default=95.0]
